limitations: Not the capital-planning case: ground truth is fragmented across agencies.
Coastal: inundation, not just subsidence, drives the story.
GUNW posting 80 m: city scale, not building scale.

The 2-year mock window (62 dates, 732 d = 2.00 annual cycles) DOES identify the seasonal term: 2.00 cycles clears the 0.75-yr-per-harmonic gate and designs at condition 4.1 (limit 30), so seasonal_amp_mm is fitted and published — the previous 132-day window (0.36 cycles / 66.8) could not. The mock is noise-free in time, so the fit recovers the injected 12 mm exactly; a real 2-year stack would carry an uncertainty this artefact does not.
MOCK: every number is synthesised by pipeline/generate_mock.py; validate the map and the schema, never the science.

Context geography (land use, water, infrastructure) is derived from an OpenStreetMap extract (data through 2026-11-15T10:08:34Z) under the ODbL 1.0: OSM land use is de facto and incomplete, so 2434 of 4936 published cells (49.3 %) are `unknown` — either no mapped polygon contains their centroid, or the containing polygon's tags map to no class of the frozen land-use vocabulary. Both causes stay `unknown` and neither is extrapolated from a neighbouring cell.
name: Jakarta, ID
null_policy: A cell is absent from nisar_grid.parquet in exactly two cases: (a) its centroid falls outside the coverage ellipse, and (b) its modelled coherence is below thresholds.coherence_min, i.e. it is a decorrelating surface (water, specular/coastal cells, the low-look coverage edge). Nodata is never written as 0: a cell carries a displacement or it does not exist. A missing date is a missing timeseries row, never a sentinel value.

provenance.license: Synthetic displacement field (mock) — no third-party data for the SAR values; context layers © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0
provenance.method: Synthetic field, no observation: secular velocity v = peak*exp(-d(peak_lonlat)/falloff) + N(0, noise) per H3 res-9 cell (config/study_cases.yaml mock block); cumulative displacement d(t) = v*(t-t_first) + A_seasonal*(cos(2*pi*(t-c)/yr) - cos(2*pi*c/yr)) with c the centre of the observation window, so both endpoints carry the same seasonal offset and val_t1 = 0 mm at the reference epoch; val_t1/val_t2 are d(t) at the first/last date; velocity_mm_yr, seasonal_amp_mm, ratio_R, regime, trend_mm_yr and seasonal_mm are ALL outputs of one joint fit per cell by pipeline.science.transforms.harmonic_fit over the whole window (2 annual harmonic(s), README §6 P6), not values copied from the config; ratio_R = abs(velocity_mm_yr)/seasonal_amp_mm and regime is transforms.classify_regime on the same pair; cells below the frozen coherence_min are dropped, so water and other decorrelating surfaces are absent rather than zero; coherence and risk bands are deterministic spatial rules; land use is joined from the OpenStreetMap extract (water, infrastructure and admin layers come from the same extract) and the published land_use polygons are the dissolved H3 cells of this grid, one per class, so the layer and the column share one assignment.
provenance.reference: Synthetic; peak rates parameterised from config/study_cases.yaml published_rate_mm_yr and docs/data-contract-v1.md v1.1. Not a measurement.

per_cell_series.criterion: aoi aggregate only (default): one row per date per case. Per-cell rows are opt-in (--per-cell-series) and capped at 3 MiB per case
